title: Neighbor saw backyard lit up like a Hollywood set

tellings.quote: goes he goes your backyard was lit up like a Hollywood set or something

plain: In 2017, a neighbour of Mario Woods, a former guard at a nuclear site, told him that his backyard in Georgia had been "lit up like a Hollywood set." Woods passes on the neighbour's words as an outside account of a strange light at his home on the night he connects with an abduction.
